The request to like, share, comment, and subscribe is ordinary audience engagement.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The main content teaches or discusses practical ways to work from home, including clothing production, food sales, freelance work and childcare services.

evidence.observation: The speaker introduces the video as a discussion of business ideas.
evidence.quote: We will share few business ideas with you

evidence.observation: The speaker describes making clothes as home-based work, mentions buying tools, and explicitly distinguishes the idea from an investment.
evidence.quote: you can increase your confidence and can earn with your money by designing dresses, making clothes, or by doing some decent work at home This is not an investment but you can start by buying the tools and then start earning money

evidence.observation: The speaker suggests starting a prepared-food business by selling dishes.
evidence.quote: you can start with one or two dishes if you sell the curry points with good taste

evidence.observation: The speaker describes payment for completed freelance work.
evidence.quote: After completing that work, and submitting it to them they will give you the amount

evidence.observation: The speaker suggests charging customers for childcare.
evidence.quote: You can start a baby care center. If you leave your children at work. Or when you decide you will leave your children for some time, You can charge them for that.
